title: Injective module presheaf cocycle lifting with larger coefficient universe
statement: Let C have objects in Type u and homs in Type v. Let R be a presheaf of rings in Type (max v w), and let M be an injective object [def-sp-injective-resolutions] in PresheafOfModules.{max v w} R [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Let T : Type (max v w), f : T -> C, hom_t : f(t) -> U, and let S be chosen iterated fibre products and index maps [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. For q >= 0, every c in Cech cochains of M.presheaf in degree q+1 with differential zero has a primitive b in degree q with differential b=c. No topology, sheafification, sheaf condition or covering condition is assumed. Coefficients and indices are large enough for all hom sets.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03FC (lemma-injective-module-trivial-cech), via Lemmas 03FB and 03AT, and the underlying-abelian identification in Lemma 03FD

proof.text: Replace C by ULiftHom.{w} C, which has the same objects and hom universe max v w. Precompose R and M with the down functor. To prove the new M injective, pull each mono and morphism back along up, use objectwise injectivity to retain the mono, apply Injective.factors in the original module category, and reuse its components on the lifted category. Naturality and the factorization equality follow componentwise. This is the fully proved private helper liftModule_injective.

Lift every product projection and index map by ULift.up. Given a compatible cone, lower its arrows, use the original product universal property, and lift its unique mediating arrow. The lifted degree-zero projection law follows from functoriality of eqToHom. This constructs liftCech without any postponed verification.

Apply the already proved common-universe cocycle theorem to the lifted category, ring presheaf, injective module presheaf, and chosen products. All hom, ring, module, and index universes now equal max v w. Cochains and differentialValue reduce definitionally to the original ones, giving the primitive with the exact original conclusion.

proof_origin.place: T2: fully formalized transport along Mathlib ULiftHom of the common-universe presheaf cocycle proof of Tag 03FC, via Tags 03AS, 03F5 and 03AT. No new postponed lemmas.

lean.statement:
theorem injective_presheaf_module_cech_cocycle_lift_max
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (R : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{max v w})
    (M : PresheafOfModules.{max v w} R) [Injective M]
    {T : Type (max v w)} {U : C} (f : T → C) (hom : ∀ t, f t ⟶ U)
    (S : SiteCechComplex f hom) (q : ℕ)
    (c : S.cochains M.presheaf (q + 1))
    (hc : S.differentialValue M.presheaf (q + 1) c = 0) :
    ∃ b : S.cochains M.presheaf q, S.differentialValue M.presheaf q b = c
